method: Direct visual inspection of every final PNG with view_image; numeric QA is separately recorded.

cnr_full_trajectories.png.review: All 12 sphere/route panels, shared per-panel vertical scales and own iteration ranges; initial undefined CNR omitted, late noise and negative values retained.

crc_full_trajectories.png.review: All 12 sphere/route panels and own iteration ranges; fixed 3D truth ROI and negative recovery retained, no fitted gain.

density_noise_curves.png.review: Three systems, common per-metric vertical scale, actual background CV, peaks and density quantiles; labels and legends readable.

integral_position_curves.png.review: Three systems, full native 120mm metrics, source integral and z leakage; nonunique initial peak location omitted and labels readable.

overall_mip72_12_routes.png.review: All 12 routes included; new and transport EHE use 0-200, JSCC uses 0-10000; own iteration labels, source legend and fixed scales readable at full resolution.

synthetic_axial.png.review: Actual axial plane, truth and all selected new EHE iterations; labels, orientation and fixed color scale readable.

synthetic_coronal.png.review: Actual coronal plane and native physical aspect ratio; whitespace is intentional, no clipping of panels or labels.

synthetic_mip72.png.review: Three new EHE routes, actual 72mm MIP, own iteration titles and fixed truth density scale; visible late noise retained.

synthetic_sagittal.png.review: Actual sagittal plane and native physical aspect ratio; whitespace is intentional, no clipping of panels or labels.

scientific_basis: Existing H60 3D truth and 3D fractional sphere ROI; crop0, no smoothing, no fitted gain; fixed emitted-source truth density scale.
